title: Mega Menu Panel — Services
description: Services mega menu panel. Combines the shared card shell (styles/sections/menu/mega-menu-panel.json: background/border/shadow/padding) with this panel's own 2-column, 3-row phase-pair grid layout in ONE variation, rather than two coexisting ones. JSON limitation confirmed empirically 2026-08-11 against wp-includes/block-supports/block-style-variations.php:92 ("Only the first block style variation with data is supported") — WordPress only ever renders the FIRST is-style-* class with registered data found on a block; a second style-variation className on the same element is silently ignored, full stop, regardless of how it's authored. This pattern's root group therefore carries only is-style-mega-menu-panel-services, not is-style-mega-menu-panel alongside it. If the shared shell styling in mega-menu-panel.json ever changes, update both files — WordPress core has no way to compose two block-style variations on one block. Uses CSS grid rather than the columns block's native flex-wrap: flex-wrap sized each wrapped row's two columns independently from that row's own content, so shorter labels (Discover/Create) and longer ones (Build/Launch) produced visibly inconsistent gaps between rows. Grid tracks are shared across all rows, so column widths — and the phase pairing itself — stay fixed regardless of label length or viewport width.
